label: Nouns — Education & Science
description: A 20-question check on education and science nouns.

questions.prompt: What does «наука» mean in «Наука быстро развивается сегодня»?
questions.explain: Наука means 'science'; the sentence says science is developing quickly today.

questions.prompt: What does «образование» mean in «Хорошее образование очень важно»?
questions.explain: Образование means 'education', praised as very important in the sentence.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'language' in Russian, as in «Русский язык очень сложный»?
questions.explain: Язык means 'language'; the sentence calls the Russian language very complex.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'knowledge' in Russian, as in «Знание это настоящая сила»?
questions.explain: Знание means 'knowledge', stated to be real power in this proverb-style sentence.

questions.prompt: In «Я очень люблю науку», what case is «науку»?
questions.explain: Науку is the accusative direct object of «люблю»; hard feminine nouns take -у.

questions.prompt: In «Он давно занимается наукой», what case is «наукой»?
questions.explain: Наукой is the instrumental governed by «заниматься», which takes the instrumental for an activity.

questions.prompt: In «У него нет высшего образования», why is «образования» in the genitive?
options: it is the subject of the sentence
questions.explain: After «нет» (there is no...), the noun «образования» stands in the genitive of negation.

questions.prompt: Which form correctly completes «Он гордится своим ___» (he is proud of his education)?
questions.explain: «Гордиться» governs the instrumental, so the form is «образованием».

questions.prompt: Which form correctly completes «Я изучаю русский ___» (I am studying the Russian language)?
questions.explain: Masculine inanimate «язык» keeps the nominative form as the accusative object of «изучаю».

questions.prompt: What is the gender of «наука»?
questions.explain: Наука is a feminine noun, as the lesson notes and its -а ending show.

questions.prompt: What is the gender of «образование»?
questions.explain: Образование is a neuter -ие noun, so its accusative matches the nominative.

questions.prompt: What is the gender of «класс» in «Наш класс очень дружный»?
questions.explain: Класс is a masculine noun, agreeing with the masculine possessive «наш».

questions.prompt: In «Меня интересуют точные науки», what form is «науки»?
questions.explain: Науки is the nominative plural subject of «интересуют» (the exact sciences interest me).

questions.prompt: In «Я знаю много интересных историй», why does «историй» have a zero ending?
options: it is the genitive plural after the quantifier «много»
questions.explain: «Много» governs the genitive plural, and «историй» is that form with a zero ending.

questions.prompt: What does the full sentence «У этой истории счастливый конец» mean?
options: This story has a happy ending.
I love the history of Russia.
We are talking about this story.
questions.explain: «У этой истории счастливый конец» states that this story has a happy ending.

questions.prompt: What does the full sentence «Без образования трудно найти работу» mean?
options: Without education it is hard to find work.
questions.explain: «Без образования трудно найти работу» means without education it is hard to find work.

questions.prompt: What does «опыт» mean in «У него большой опыт работы»?
questions.explain: Опыт means 'experience'; the sentence says he has a lot of work experience.

questions.prompt: What does «статья» mean in «Эта статья очень полезная»?
questions.explain: Статья means 'article'; the sentence calls this article very useful.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'novel' in Russian, as in «Этот роман очень длинный»?
questions.explain: Роман means 'novel'; the sentence says this novel is very long.

questions.prompt: In «Я свободно владею английским языком», what case is «языком» and why?
questions.explain: «Владеть» governs the instrumental, so «языком» is instrumental (I have a fluent command of English).
